#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# Every Scenarios entry (Debug Mode -> Scenarios) sets up and lands where it should, without crashing.
# Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_scenarios_test.py.
# --- S1
# (power-on)
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press DOWN
press A
wait 30
expect *sMainMenu+4 4 == 53
wait 10
shot s01_pick
press A
mash A gDungeon 4 != 0 1800
wait 600
shot s01_in_dungeon
expect gDxScenario 1 == 1
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonLocation 1 == 0
expect *gDungeon+@gDxOffDungeonFloor 1 == 1
